preference.alt: A researcher leans over a glowing topographic relief model, reaching toward one chosen point among scattered markers.

openskizze.alt: An older planner at a rooftop parapet watches pale cold-air streams thread between the roofs and courtyards below.

openskizze-praxis.alt: A planner with long locs sits at a monitor, chin in hand, studying abstract map parcels and wind arrows.

cytotransport.alt: An older biophysicist uses tweezers to place an ion bead into a cutaway glass model of a membrane channel.

ummbas.alt: Two researchers in VR headsets cup their hands around a small shared molecular wireframe in a dark lab.

digital-twin.alt: An engineer kneels beside a workbench, comparing a small service robot with a lime wireframe building on her tablet.

aeromat.alt: An aerodynamicist in profile watches coral smoke streamlines pass an airfoil model in a wind tunnel.

elabor.alt: A planner places charge-point markers along a route on a city map, an electric car visible through the window.

kiss-bis.alt: A sprinter and a sports scientist sit shoulder to shoulder on a track bench, reading a motion trace on a tablet.

bitbots.alt: A young engineer sits on the floor of a home test arena while a small service robot offers a cup between faint perception cones.

nifti.alt: A rescue operator kneels beside a tracked robot in a collapsed concrete interior, its searchlight probing the rubble.

models.alt: An older person in a cardigan studies a branching network diagram at a desk, thread-connected cards pinned above.

search.alt: A young woman with a lantern stands in a vast archive, facing a constellation of countless candidate cards.

interfaces.alt: A human hand with a pencil and a mechanical drafting hand with a pen meet over a faintly glowing drawing surface.

practice.alt: An older mentor leans over blueprints with two students, guiding them from a sketch toward a small physical model.

music.alt: A man plays a grand piano alone at night, eyes closed, one hand lifted above the keys.

writing.alt: A writer reads back a handwritten page at a lamplit desk, a stack of finished pages beside her.

cooking.alt: An Indonesian woman tosses a wok in a home kitchen, steam rising among spice jars and shallots.

growing.alt: An older gardener kneels by a raised seedling bed at the city edge, pressing soil around young plants.

outside.alt: A lone cyclist climbs a rainy moorland road, small against dark hills and low cloud.

questions.alt: A seated woman rests her chin on her hand while abstract ideas orbit her in the dark.
